=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:596-2176 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: On an orchestrator/project-* integration-sync head, the modify/delete take-base runs `git rm` on a file whose merged sub-issue must_contain fingerprint then has nothing to match. The tail at lines 1478-1487 sets `_mu_defer_commit=true` and `_det_commit_scope="modify-delete-only"`. The fingerprint expansion (lines 2093-2115) fills FP_VIOLATED_FILES_LIST, and the deferred-commit gate at lines 2173-2176 runs `exit 1` with "detail=fingerprint_violations". The hand-off at lines 2155-2171 has no `modify-delete-only` case.
  WHY: Before this PR the conflict went to the model resolver with fingerprint context and retry state. Now prepare fails hard on every run and leaves no retry state, which the comment at lines 2161-2165 calls a regression. The guard-hook tail skip when `_mdd_resolved=true` (line 1438) widens this path. Reviewer severity is MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash stated that the mdd tail at scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:1477-1493 still defers so the fingerprint check is never skipped, but it did not address the hard-exit path.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:731 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `norm` function uses `.lstrip()` instead of `.strip()` to normalize diff lines for the containment-test sweep detection.
  WHY: Trailing whitespace may affect how accurately sweeps are detected. The reviewer agrees `lstrip` matches the comment "leading whitespace stripped" but calls it brittle. Reviewer severity is NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Report dropped edits on the PR: the existing resolver success summary lists each path with its deleting PR and a 10-line excerpt of the dropped diff. That reuses the existing comment; there is no new comment." (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:263, Phase 4 item 2)
  expected_change_site: the existing resolver success-summary comment path (`host_only_take_base_comment.md` / `_conflict_prepare_post_host_only_comment` and the existing success-summary loop) in scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh and scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: A new comment file `${RUNTIME_DIR}/modify_delete_take_base_comment.md` (marker `<!-- ai:modify-delete-take-base:v1 pr=<n> head=<sha> -->`) is posted separately through the new `_conflict_prepare_post_modify_delete_comment` in scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh, and through the `for _resolver_take_base_comment in ... modify_delete_take_base_comment.md; do` loop in scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh (lines 5461, 5473). The existing success-summary comment is not extended and never lists modify/delete take-base paths. The editor accepted this as a known deviation (CONSOLIDATOR_OVERRIDDEN ISSUE 005). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash declined to re-raise it for that reason.
- requirement: The plan's Phase 4 deliverable "the prompts/conflict-resolver.txt context section" (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md line 185; file list at :417-427; plan step 3 at line 264) asks for an instruction to either keep the modify/delete file or `git rm` it, so an unmerged path is never left untouched (the #9452 root cause).
  expected_change_site: prompts/conflict-resolver.txt (Rules/Output sections), or the stage-context text that `_resolver_modify_delete_context` writes in scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2869-2880)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The last autofix removed the PR's only change to prompts/conflict-resolver.txt, and the file is no longer in PR CHANGED FILES. Three static rules still conflict with the modify/delete flow: line 29 "Do not modify files that do not contain conflict markers.", line 50 "Any file you modify that did NOT contain conflict markers will abort the run with no commit", and the line 61 self-check. Neither the stage-context block in `_resolver_modify_delete_context` nor the unmerged_left prelude in `_build_retry_prompt` says these paths are an exception. Reviewer severities were MAJOR (sonnet) and NIT (minimax). z-ai_glm-5_3-flash considers the deliverable met functionally and the conflict covered by the unmerged_left in-loop retry.
- requirement: "Setting the switch to `false` must restore today's behaviour." (plan body; README and `agents.d/9886-modify-delete-take-base.md` say "`false` restores the previous behaviour")
  expected_change_site: `prompts/conflict-resolver.txt` lines 30-36 (the static modify/delete rule) and `tests/test_review_conflict_modify_delete.py::test_switch_defaults_and_forwarding`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The previous autofix removed the static modify/delete rule from `prompts/conflict-resolver.txt`, and `test_switch_defaults_and_forwarding` now asserts the rule is absent. With `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED=false`, `_resolver_modify_delete_context` returns 0 before appending its block, so the model gets no modify/delete guidance. Reviewer severity was BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash refute this: the rule did not exist on the base branch, so removing it restores the pre-PR prompt.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:596-850, 1478-1487, 2093-2115, 2155-2176 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On an orchestrator/project-* head, the take-base `git rm`s a file the integration branch changed through a merged sub-issue sweep. scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py lines 1426-1437 report "file does not exist in post-resolve tree". The empty allowlist plus `comm -23` keeps the path in FP_VIOLATED_FILES_LIST, and the deferred commit hits `exit 1` with fingerprint_violations, because the `modify-delete-only` scope has no resolver hand-off.
  WHY: Prepare fails hard every run with no retry state, where before the PR the conflict went to the model resolver with fingerprint context. The guard-hook tail skip at line 1438 when `_mdd_resolved=true` widens the path. Fix: (a) skip the take-base when IS_INTEGRATION_SYNC=true or the head is orchestrator/project-*, logging reason=integration_sync; or (b) skip paths that appear in INTEGRATION_FINGERPRINTS_FILE.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh take-base candidate loop (second `while IFS= read -r _mdd_path` loop, lines ~678-704). Before adding to eligible.tsv, skip with `reason=fingerprinted` when IS_INTEGRATION_SYNC=true and `grep -Fq -- "\"${_mdd_path}\"" "${INTEGRATION_FINGERPRINTS_FILE}"` matches. Estimated ~5 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Phase 4 deliverable "the prompts/conflict-resolver.txt context section" (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md line 185); plan step 3 (line 264): keep the modify/delete file or `git rm` it, never leave an unmerged path untouched (#9452 root cause).
  Expected change site: prompts/conflict-resolver.txt, or the stage-context text that `_resolver_modify_delete_context` writes in scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh (the second keeps the `false` rollback byte-identical).
  Evidence of absence: The last autofix removed the PR's only prompts/conflict-resolver.txt change. Static lines 29, 50 and 61 still say to leave files without markers alone. The stage-context block and the `_build_retry_prompt` unmerged_left prelude do not mark these paths as an exception, so the instructions contradict each other and the retry spends attempts before `exit_class=scope`. Fix: add one exception sentence to the `_resolver_modify_delete_context` block.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Pass-1 notes, not raised (2 related items): the minimax "switch=false no longer restores today's prompt" BLOCKER is wrong, because the prompt is unchanged from base; the new `ai:modify-delete-take-base:v1` comment instead of the reused success summary is an accepted deviation (ISSUE 005) and is not part of the Phase 4 "Done" criterion (plan line 186).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
